author: flossdaily
body:
Hello staff! I've recently tried to log onto only to find that I've been temporarily banned for four days. The reason being swearing and caps in two reports that I made during a game. I hope you can imagine that I was pretty confused, because the Sr. Mod who was on at the time and saw my reports replied nicely and told me that it wasn't exactly team griefing, even though he was technically helping the other team out. I immediately realized I had wrongfully gotten all angry, and I stopped the reports. I left him to do his thing and for me to just do my best at the defense.

However, then I attempt to log on in the morning and find I had been banned for a couple days... by a Map Dev (probably a mod as well) who wasn't even in the game at the time of the reports?! While this probably doesn't seem like a big deal to you, I hope you can understand that I play on this server pretty much every day and it's the main thing I get on Minecraft to do. If you staff members see this appeal and truly believe I deserve the punishment, I'll take it. Personally, it just felt like a little much. I wasn't warned by the Sr. Mod and had no idea this was coming because I played a bit after the match with the reports.

I fully understand I am in the wrong with caps lock and swearing with the two reports, but I'd also like to point out I've been doing all that way less frequently and this has been a one time thing for the past couple of weeks. (Of course I have some infractions before when I got super salty, easily, but I'm getting past that).

Anyways, I hope you review this and can sympathize and understand my perspective on the situation. Thanks for your time!

replies.author: flossdaily
replies.body: Alright, and why are appeals public to the forums? It seems kinda like a private issue between staff and player. Is there any way to make it just so the staff see it?

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: Appeals are not public to the forums, only you can see your own. The only people that can see your appeals are staff.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
As for your judgement, I found that the Moderator used proper judgement in the action taken, and I will be keeping the ban instituted. 

This appeal is denied.
